name: dev-conventions
description: On-demand references for what a repo cannot state by being read: the house Python pinning policy and the two mistakes behind most Pydantic/Pyright diagnostic walls; documentation conventions (last-updated dates, where unshared notes and session logs live, how dependency changes are recorded, no decorative counts in prose); and a uv and bun dependency CVE audit, transitives included. No hooks or ambient injection: conventions belong in each repo's own always-loaded files.
